spiritgiven.comments: Overall it was a great intense game. Everything went as per our initial discussion. The USA team had good spirit and attitude towards the team was good

We had conversation with team Canada regarding spirit and attitude towards our players. 
Some of the sideline talk were demeaning towards our team, with specific comments towards our team's performance. We were unable to communicate that to the Canadian team, which we'll bring up with them tomorrow. There were no dangerous plays during the game and most fouls were talked thru well. We communicated about low physicality, but we felt some players were still physical during cuts.
It was great spirit from the HK team! We loved playing against them

Travel and fast counts were used again. There were couple of dangerous plays that did not result in any major injuries but could have been. Otherwise their attitude was great and it was fun on the sidelines.
There were some disparities in the knowledge of rules. Some calls on their side had incorrect knowledge of rules use. It didn't impact the play significantly but it can improve on their side

Overall the sideline and on field communication did not feel spirited. There were a couple of instances where the chat after a call was not calm. 
Some calls that were held or retracted seemed in favor of their team and there were instances of excessive calls being made that didn't impact play.
There was some disagreement over rule knowledge and use, but we think overall they knew their rules well.
Most calls were resolved very nicely between players on the field. A stall call was retracted with good spirits from their team. Their attitude was great on and off the field.
Very positive on the sidelines and on the field. They were receptive to conversation and talk the calls out. Players were very respectful of our team. It was a great game overall
It was a good game overall. There were a few calls, but very quickly resolved.
It was a very spirited game. There were some calls but mostly resolved on the field
It was a great game. The second half was slightly more physical. There couple of instances that we thought could have been dangerous, but good conversation was had about them.

spiritreceived.comments: Great game! Positive attitude and concern with collisions made it feel safe and competitive.

Thanks India for a great game, we loved your attitude and fair mindedness during discussions. A few minor points for improvement would be to learn some of the rules/processes of resetting the disc back into play after calls/discussions and adhering to time limits. We identified that both teams could be better at using and echoing hand signals on the field.
A lot of contact and physical game in the second half - M
Thank you for a great communication during the game! It was a very enjoyable game!

Great positivity and proactive chats on the sideline. We felt there are a couple of areas of improvement as we mentioned in the spirit circle: Rules knowledge, push off contact on the male side, better communication on the field using hand signals, timeliness of discussions and seeking resolution within 45 seconds, moving any further conversations to the sideline after the point if necessary.
We respect your fair-mindedness in accepting people's opinions.And we can play a better game if we are more clear with our calls and hand signals.Thank you!
Thank you for a great game! Good communication and spirit. Playing y’all a second time and seein y’all level up from the first game was amazing. Thank you for the new dance keeping us on our toes!
